villa_snapshot: Property snapshot
Close to Khori Jamalpur Jheel and Mini Ladakh, this 2-BHK villa in a peaceful forest resort offers the perfect retreat to explore nature and culture in complete comfort.

Tucked away in the heart of the forest, the property blends rustic charm with modern ease. Surrounded by lush gardens and plantations of fruits and vegetables, it carries a refreshing farm-to-table appeal. With wide lawns, open greenery, and a serene natural setting, it’s ideal for family escapes, intimate getaways, or grand celebrations and events.

The rooms are warm and inviting, featuring king-size beds, soft lighting, elegant décor, and windows opening to tranquil forest views. Each ensuite bathroom comes with modern fittings, showers, and organic toiletries, ensuring both comfort and care. The living spaces flow with natural light, cosy sofas, cushioned chairs, and curated art—perfect for relaxed conversations or quiet downtime.

Guests can enjoy the vibrant reception lounge, dine in style at the 60-seater restaurant with indoor and scenic outdoor seating, or unwind in the library with plush seating and a collection of books. Leisure comes alive with a dedicated game zone, a gym and sauna for wellness, and a beautiful swimming pool framed by palm trees, stone pathways, and a spacious deck. The poolside gazebo adds a laid-back charm, offering the perfect spot to unwind with garden and cottage views.

Trained under the ethos of Atithi Devo Bhava, our hospitality team ensures every guest feels deeply cared for. Every corner of the resort is designed for relaxation, from its music-filled common areas to its peaceful outdoor garden spaces.
